purpose: Semantic fixed-step input Actions and host/virtual input without scanning the input header tree.
read_policy: Prefer semantic ActionMap authoring for gameplay. Open only the named exact header when a less-common control or signature needs confirmation.

contracts.summary: Author semantic bindings with AddButtonAction()/BindButton() and AddAxis1DAction(). Application finalizes OnStart-authored actions and resolves them before each Game::OnFixedUpdate callback.
Query ButtonActionId state during fixed-step gameplay; Axis1D(Axis1DActionId) returns the resolved semantic axis value.
Use Actions() inside Game callbacks for the authoritative semantic map; use Input() only for lower-level physical state when explicitly needed.
Host/test/Agent input converges through Application before fixed-step action resolution. ScheduleInput(frame, event) is the deterministic future-frame path.
